scope: Tick model runtime only plus the existing controlled downstream fixture; model loading and input construction excluded.
notes: The committed path uses float32 weights with four independent AVX2 accumulators and explicit FMA; it preserves the original model architecture and activation functions.
FP16 conversion overhead was slower than float32 on this CPU.
The experimental AVX2 INT8 path was slower and accumulated materially different recurrent outputs, so it is not enabled by the committed path.
